pre_install: Get-Process -Name 'Hayase' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { if ($_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0) { $_.CloseMainWindow() | Out-Null; if (-not $_.WaitForExit(5000)) { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } else { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }
pre_uninstall: Get-Process -Name 'Hayase' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { if ($_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0) { $_.CloseMainWindow() | Out-Null; if (-not $_.WaitForExit(5000)) { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } else { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }

script: if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Hayase installer exited with code $($process.ExitCode)" }
